snippet.title: ULTRA CORE DIVE - OFFICIAL TRAILER
snippet.description:
OUT NOW ON STEAM!!!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3664120/ULTRA_CORE_DIVE/

SHOOT AND DODGE your way into the depths of the planet 
in this Dark Chaotic Arcade Twinstick Shooter! Don't get consumed by the noise!

Ultra Core Dive is a dark and chaotic arcade twinstick shooter inspired by the masters of the genre. The game features a dark retro inspired pseudo-1bit aesthetic with tons of action on screen.
